name: SiteFooter
label: Site footer
description: The bottom of a site: brand, columns of links, and a row of small print and social links.

props.name: columns
props.description: The sitemap columns, in order along the row.

props.name: brand
props.description: The brand at the start of the footer: a logo, a name, or both.

props.name: description
props.description: A line about the site under the brand.

props.name: social
props.description: Social or utility controls for the bottom row's end, such as IconButtons.

props.name: legal
props.description: The bottom row's small print: a copyright, a licence, a privacy link.

props.name: navigationLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the navigation landmark that holds the columns.

props.name: externalLabel
props.description: Text read after an external link's name, for a screen reader.

props.name: linkComponent
props.description:
The component its links render with, such as Next.js's `Link`. A plain
`<a>` when unset. Server-renderable, so it reads no LinkProvider: pass
it here.

LinkComponent.description: A component that renders a link in place of a plain `<a>`, such as a router's.

LinkComponentProps.description:
The props a link component receives: every anchor attribute, the ref, and
an `href` that is always a string. Next.js's `Link` takes these as they
are; a router whose link takes `to` instead needs a one-line adapter:
`({ href, ...props }) => <RouterLink to={href} {...props} />`.

SiteFooterColumn.description: A titled column of footer links.

SiteFooterLink.description: One link in a footer column.

keys.note: Plain links: the browser owns Tab and Enter.
